title: The Pink Champagne New Year's Eve Girls' Night In
description: A pink New Year's Eve girls' night in from Amazon: feather trim satin pajamas, blush pink ribbed coupe glasses, a rhinestone Happy New Year headband, pink mini disco balls, fuzzy slippers and pink sequin pillows.
intro: Last New Year's Eve I got dressed up, paid for parking and was home by 10:40 because my feet hurt. Never again. This year the party is in my living room and the dress code is feather trim pajamas. I picked blush pink coupe glasses with gold rims, a rhinestone Happy New Year headband, a bowl of tiny pink disco balls, sequin pillows for the couch and fuzzy slippers so nobody's feet hurt. Bring snacks. Leave by 12:05.

sections.heading: What we're wearing
paragraphs: The MORFORU feather trim satin pajama set in Lotus Root Pink (it comes with a matching satin headband, eye mask and scrunchie), the Noonhorse rhinestone Happy New Year headband in rose gold and the Crazy Lady fuzzy cross band slippers in pink.

sections.heading: What makes it a party
paragraphs: GLASSIQUE CADEAU blush pink ribbed coupe glasses with gold rims (a set of 4), a 20 pack of MTLEE pink mini disco balls and a set of 2 Poise3EHome pink sequin pillow covers, 18 x 18 in.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, snacks, sofa and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
